meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的 Discord bot 接进系统:复制好代码、装好依赖、让你在 Discord 官网建一个机器人并把令牌贴给它,再把服务重启,之后你就能在 Discord 私聊或频道里直接和它对话了。
howto.when: 当你在 `/setup` 流程中要求添加 Discord 通道,或使用 `/init-first-agent`、`/manage-channels` 命令来接入聊天平台时。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接进来
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并询问 Discord 令牌。

say.text: 在 Discord 开发者平台创建了 Bot,现在给你粘贴令牌
say.note: 粘贴后 Claude 会校验并存储凭证。

say.text: 为我设置 Discord 频道,并邀请机器人到我的服务器
say.note: Claude 会完成注册、重启并解析私聊频道。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude integrates your Discord bot into the system: it copies the adapter code, installs the dependency, asks you to create a bot on Discord's website and paste its token, then restarts the service. You can then chat with Claude directly via Discord DMs or channels.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you ask to add Discord as a channel during the /setup flow, or when you use the /init-first-agent or /manage-channels commands to connect a chat platform.

say_en.text: Connect my Discord bot for me
say_en.note: Claude will copy the adapter and ask for your Discord token.

say_en.text: I created the bot on the Developer Portal, here is the token
say_en.note: Claude validates and stores the credential after you paste it.

say_en.text: Set up a Discord channel and invite the bot to my server
say_en.note: Claude will register, restart, and resolve your DM channel.
